units.source_text: 二人暂时歇息，到了将近中午，方才起身。

en.t: The two rested for a while, and only got up when it was nearly noon.

units.source_text: 源氏公子亲自打开格子窗一看，庭院中荒芜之极，不见人影，

en.t: Prince Genji opened the lattice window himself and looked out; the garden was utterly desolate, with not a person in sight,

units.source_text: 但见树木丛生，一望无际，寂寥之趣，难于言喻。

en.t: only trees growing thickly as far as the eye could see, with a loneliness impossible to put into words.

units.source_text: 附近的花卉草木，也都毫不足观，只觉得是一片衰秋的原野。

en.t: The nearby flowers, grasses, and trees were all entirely unremarkable; it felt only like a field in late autumn decline.

units.source_text: 池塘上覆着水草，荒凉可怕。

en.t: The pond was covered with water plants, bleak and frightening.

units.source_text: 那边的离屋里设有房间，似乎有人住着，然而相隔很远。

en.t: There were rooms in a detached building over there, and someone seemed to be living there, but it was very far away.

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“这地方人迹全无，阴风惨惨的。

en.t: Prince Genji said, "There is no trace of people in this place, and the gloomy wind feels bitterly cold.

units.source_text: 可是即使有鬼，对我也无可奈何吧。”

en.t: But even if there are demons here, surely they can do nothing to me."

units.source_text: 这时候他的脸还是隐蔽着。

en.t: Even then, his face was still hidden.

units.source_text: 夕颜对此似有怨恨之色。
源氏公子想：“亲昵到了这地步，还要遮掩真面目，确实是不合情理的。”

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "Now that we have become this intimate, it truly makes no sense for me still to hide my real face."
